stories.headline: Florida Panthers set a hat-trick record in three straight games
stories.summary: The Florida Panthers have become the first team in the National Hockey League to record a natural hat trick in three consecutive games. A natural hat trick is three consecutive goals by one player, uninterrupted by any other player scoring for either team. The league's fastest took 21 seconds, set by Bill Mosienko in 1952.

stories.headline: Vietnam signs a free trade deal with four European nations
stories.summary: Vietnam has signed a free trade agreement with the European Free Trade Association, whose members are Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. It reduces or eliminates tariffs on industrial, agricultural and fish products. The agreement also covers services, intellectual property and sustainable development.

stories.headline: Hairless dogs found at an ancient Peruvian burial complex
stories.summary: Archaeologists working at an ancient burial complex in Peru have found evidence of hairless dogs that lived more than 1,200 years ago, long before the rise of the Inca Empire. The complex, Castillo de Huarmey, lies approximately 190 miles north of Lima and covers 110 acres. It was occupied between 600 and 1050 CE.
